column7: Securities financing transaction identification information, type (repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing) and other parameters.

column10: Specifies the type of securities financing transaction, that is, repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing.
Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.
Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.
Settlement transaction has already been sent on the market. It is sent by an account owner to an account servicer for reconciliation purposes.
Sequential number of the instruction in a range of linked settlement instructions.
Total number of settlement instructions that are linked together.

column7: Information related to a linked transaction.

column10: Specifies when the transaction is to be executed relative to a linked transaction.
Message type number/message identifier of the message referenced in the linkage sequence.
Reference to the linked transaction.
Quantity of financial instruments of the linked transaction to be paired-off or turned.
Party that generates the reference.
Market in which a trade transaction has been executed.

Infrastructure which may be a component of a clearing house and which facilitates clearing and settlement for its members by standing between the buyer and the seller. It may net transactions and it substitutes itself as settlement counterparty for each position.
Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.
Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

Specifies the price of the traded financial instrument.|This is the deal price of the individual trade transaction. |If there is only one trade transaction for the execution of the trade, then the deal price could equal the executed trade price (unless, for example, the price includes commissions or rounding, or some other factor has been applied to the deal price or the executed trade price, or both).
Number of days on which the interest rate accrues (daily accrual note).
Specifies that a trade is to be reported to a third party.
Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.
Specifies the role of the investor in the transaction.
Specifies the role of the trading party in the transaction.
Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds or to sell the indicated currency in order to obtain the necessary currency to fund the transaction.
Status of affirmation of a trade.
Provides the matching status of the instruction.
Provides additional settlement processing information which cannot be included within the structured fields of the message.
Provides additional details pertaining to foreign exchange instructions.

column7: Details on a quantity, account and other related information.

column10: Total quantity of securities to be settled.
Denomination of the security to be received or delivered.
Party that legally owns the account.
Account to or from which a securities entry is made.
Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.
Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).
Breakdown of a quantity into lots such as tax lots, instrument series.

column7: Details of settlement of a transaction.

column10: Specifies whether the transaction is on hold/blocked/frozen.
Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.
Conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.
Role of a party in the settlement of the transaction.
Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.
Specifies whether the settlement transaction is to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.
Specifies whether there is change of beneficial ownership.
Specifies the category of cash clearing system, for example, cheque clearing.
Tax role capacity of the instructing party.
Specifies if an instruction is for a market side or a client side transaction.
Specifies whether the foreign exchange standing instruction in place should apply.
Specifies whether the settlement instruction is a block parent or child.
Regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.
Specifies whether the settlement instruction is to be settled through the default or the alternate settlement system.
Specifies whether the settlement transaction is eligible for netting.
Specifies whether the settlement transaction is CCP (Central Counterparty) eligible.
Specifies whether the loan and/or collateral is tracked.
Condition for automatic borrowing.
Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.
Specifies whether securities should be included in the pool of securities eligible for collateral purposes.

column7: Identifies other amounts pertaining to the transaction.

column10: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.
Amount of money paid for the provision of financial services that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.
Amount of country, national or federal tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the account servicer is located.
Principal amount of a trade (price multiplied by quantity).
Amount of money paid to an executing broker as a commission.
Amount of money defined as a discount on a new issue or on a tranche of an existing issue.
Amount of payment levy tax.
Tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the financial instrument settles.
Local tax country specific.
Amount of commission paid to a local broker.
Amount of money deposited by the trading party in a margin account.
An amount that is not indicated by a known business denomination.
Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, for example, Securities and Exchange fees.
All costs related to the physical delivery of documents such as stamps, postage, carrier fees, insurances or messenger services.
Amount of drawdown or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.
Amount of stamp duty.
Amount of stock exchange tax.
Amount of tax levied on a transfer of ownership of financial instrument.
Amount of transaction tax.
Amount of value-added tax.
Amount of money that will be withheld by a tax authority.

Amount representing the difference between the cost and the current price of a security. In the context of securities settlement, it is the amount paid or received when the instructions are netted or paired off.
Amount of consumption tax.
Amount of unpaid interest (on bonds which have defaulted and have subsequently |restructured), which is capitalized and added to the original principal amount of the bond.
Charge or commission paid by the investor to a distributor/intermediary or other service provider for the provision of financial research.
Sequential number of the instruction in a range of linked settlement instructions.
Total numbers of settlement transactions, receipts and deliveries, and the concerned settlement transaction number.

Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds.
